title: France tasks Versailles director with overhauling Louvre after heist
summary: France on Wednesday appointed Christophe Leribault as the new head of the Louvre, bringing in the director of the Palace of Versailles to turn around ​the world's most-visited ‌museum after a humiliating jewellery heist and staff strikes. He will succeed Laurence des ⁠Cars, who resigned on Tuesday.
